title: a withdrawn decision stays a card
line: a decision the rule took back is a card for the owner again, and stays one when a newer matcher supersedes that card: the undecided link the withdrawal leaves is no decision, so the persona is proposed again, and taken again where the rule still would

steps.say: the 1920 page: the father accepted by the owner, the daughter taken by the rule
the daughter's decision taken back: a card again, her link undecided
the record's open cards, hers among them, marked as an older matcher's
reconsider supersedes the older cards and proposes the personas again: her undecided link does not keep her from a card

expect.why: proposed again on the same reading and taken again by the rule, which still would
